newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: PAKISTAN PM MAKES TWO ADVISERS CABINET MINISTERS.
newsitem.headline: PAKISTAN PM MAKES TWO ADVISERS CABINET MINISTERS.

text.p: Pakistani Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif named his two advisers as cabinet ministers on Monday, raising the total of full ministers in his 5-1/2-month-old cabinet to 19.
Khalid Anwar was sworn in President Farooq Leghari as minister for law, justice and human rights and Mushahid Hussain as minister for information, the state television said.

Both men, who were previously advisers for the same subjects with ministerial rank, are members of Sharif's Pakistan Muslim League party, which took power in February after a landslide election victory against former prime minister Benazir Bhutto's Pakistan People's Party.
